use_case: Generative AI assistant used to pre-screen city utility bill assistance applications into likely eligible, likely ineligible, or missing documents (proof of concept, 2026-07-27 to 2026-07-31, 25 real applications)
business_owner: Owner-consultant (city utility assistance program manager asked for it verbally)
vendor_or_model: General-purpose generative AI assistant, individual paid plan (SYS-08); no data agreement
data_categories: Applicant names, addresses, household size, income documents (pay stubs, benefit letters); 6 pay stubs showed full Social Security numbers
human_in_the_loop: None during the proof of concept: output went only to the owner, and city staff decided every application in the normal way without seeing it
applicable_laws: Contract CL-02 (city data used only for the project; confidentiality); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) and (6)(a); city program rules (city staff decide eligibility); Colorado SB26-189 not applicable (no Colorado clients)
status: Retired (stopped 2026-08-12; not to resume; city attorney deciding on resident notice)
